readiness.verdict_desc: Ready for secure development and deployment

security_profile.evidence: Full security profile documented: purpose, resources, actions, prohibited ops, auth requirements, monitoring needs. Reviewed by security team before development.

threat_modeling.evidence: OWASP Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS applied. 8 threats identified with mitigations. Missing: multi-agent coordination scenario (not applicable to current design).

least_privilege.evidence: Default deny. Each permission explicitly granted and justified. RBAC with 3 roles (read-only, standard, admin). No shared accounts. Progressive expansion documented.

secure_defaults.evidence: All logging enabled by default. Strictest permission set. Guardrails on all tool calls. 1-hour credential lifetime. Missing: automated config validation in CI.

existing_infra.evidence: Uses existing Azure Entra ID for auth. Logs to existing Sentinel SIEM. Incident response through existing SOC team. Agent-specific runbook added to IR procedures.

compliance.evidence: GDPR data handling documented. SOX audit trail requirements met. ISO 42001 checklist 80% complete. Missing: formal DPIA for automated decision-making.

findings.recommendation: Add note that multi-agent scenarios are out of scope for current design

findings.finding: Automated config validation not in CI pipeline
findings.recommendation: Add schema validation to CI/CD for agent config files
Complete DPIA before processing customer data in production

readiness.verdict_desc: Not ready -- critical security gaps must be addressed first

security_profile.evidence: Basic purpose documented. Resources and actions listed but not formally approved. Prohibited operations not defined. No monitoring requirements specified.

threat_modeling.evidence: Informal discussion of risks. No structured threat model. OWASP/ATLAS not applied. Attack vectors not mapped. Consequences not documented.

least_privilege.evidence: Some permission scoping exists (refund cap). But email access unrestricted. CRM access broad. No formal RBAC model. Default allow for most operations.

secure_defaults.evidence: Basic logging enabled. Permissions not restricted by default. Guardrails minimal. 30-day credential lifetime. No config validation.

existing_infra.evidence: Uses existing email system and CRM. Logs go to application logging (not SIEM). Incident response not integrated with SOC. Custom logging solution built.

compliance.evidence: GDPR mentioned but not detailed. PII handling informal. No formal data retention policy. No compliance review conducted.

findings.recommendation: Conduct formal threat modeling using OWASP/ATLAS before deployment
Document all prohibited operations and implement enforcement
Switch to default deny with explicit grants for each capability
Implement recipient allowlisting and rate limits
Send agent logs to existing SIEM for correlation
Conduct GDPR/HIPAA assessment before processing customer data
Replace with existing logging infrastructure to reduce maintenance
